A '''Grand Duke''' (Japanese: '''グランデューク''' ''Grand Duke'') is a type of [[Pokémon Trainer]] that debuted in [[Generation VI]]. This Trainer class is a title of nobility, granted in the [[Battle Chateau]], and Trainers with this class only appear there. Grand Duke is the highest rank of nobility for males, ranking above {{tc|Duke}}. They are the male counterparts of the {{tc|Grand Duchess}} class.

The male [[player character]] may earn the title of Grand Duke by defeating most of the Trainers in the Battle Chateau. In the games, no non-player character possesses this Trainer class.

==In animation==
[[File:Grand Duke anime.png|thumb|250px|Grant being promoted to Grand Duke in {{aniseries|XY}}]]
===''Pokémon the Series''===
In {{aniseries|PTS}}, Grand Dukes are shown wearing purple capes as a distinction from the other titles.

===={{aniseries|XY}}====
In ''[[XY020|Breaking Titles at the Chateau!]]'', [[Grant]] defeated [[Viola]] in a battle at the Battle Chateau, earning himself the title of Grand Duke as his reward.
